Class CardVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.CardVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
AddToBuildingsVisitor, BottomRowInitVisitor, BuildingPresenceVisitor, CardBottomRowControllerVisitor, CardEffectVisitor, CardTopRowControllerVisitor, CardTypifiedVisitor, CharactersPresenceVisitor, CharactersSetsVisitor, DeckCardVisitor, EventListVisitor, HunterFoodIconVisitor, InstanceSorterCardVisitor, InventorIconVisitor, InventorPairsVisitor, ShamanVisitor
public abstract class CardVisitor extends Object
The base abstract visitor for all cards in the game. It implements empty or fallback traversal methods for every specific card type, allowing concrete visitors to override only the methods they need.
